description:
`run.start_file` params: a run of one task file, with no board and no workflow (ts-0065-kx). The daemon runs the
built-in `collide/builder` role in a new worktree of `repo`, and the text of `task_file` is the first turn. It is
a call of its own, so `run.start`'s request (which `run.preview` shares) does not change.

alias.description: The model alias to run, as the user's `models.yaml` maps it. The role's default when absent.

budget_usd.description: The phase's budget in US dollars, passed to the tool when it enforces one itself.

repo.description: The checkout the worktree is made from: an absolute path.

task_file.description: The task file whose text is the phase's first turn: an absolute path.

title: RunStartFileParams
